title: Pure Charity
summary: Pure Charity draw and Normal Monster control build centered on the TCG-legal Charity series, including Common Charity and Graceful Tear, supported by classic Fairy lore and Normal Monster engines. By repeatedly summoning and recycling Normal Monsters like Dunames Dark Witch and Angel Trumpeter, the deck churns through cards via Common Charity and White Elephant's Gift to fuel Synchro and Xyz payoffs.

summary.title: Starters
points: Rescue Rabbit banishes itself from the field to Special Summon two copies of Dunames Dark Witch or Angel Trumpeter directly from the Deck.
Unexpected Dai Special Summons Dunames Dark Witch or Angel Trumpeter straight from the Deck while you control no monsters.
The Agent of Creation - Venus pays 500 LP per activation to flood the field with up to three Mystical Shine Balls from hand or Deck.
Treasure Panda banishes used Spells and Traps from your GY to Special Summon Level 1-4 Normal Monsters from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Rescue Rabbit + Common Charity
steps: Normal Summon Rescue Rabbit and banish it to Special Summon two copies of Angel Trumpeter (or Dunames Dark Witch) from your Deck.
Use the two Level 4 Normal Monsters to Xyz Summon a Rank 4 monster or Synchro Summon Avenging Knight Parshath if paired with a non-Tuner.
Alternatively, tribute one Normal Monster with White Elephant's Gift to draw 2 fresh cards.
Set Common Charity and any defensive Traps.
During the opponent's turn, activate Common Charity to draw 2 cards and banish a Normal Monster from your hand, maintaining full hand advantage.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Avenging Knight Parshath is a Level 8 Synchro that changes an opponent's monster to Defense Position when attacking and inflicts piercing battle damage.
Orea, the Sylvan High Arbiter detaches an Xyz Material to stack the top of the Deck with Plant monsters and excavates them to return opponent's cards to the hand without targeting.
Dunames Dark Witch provides a respectable 1800 ATK Normal body, while Angel Trumpeter provides a 1900 ATK Tuner body for beatdown or extra deck plays.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Common Charity draws 2 cards, then banishes 1 Normal Monster from your hand; if you have no Normal Monster to banish, your entire hand is sent to the GY, making Normal Monster density essential.
White Elephant's Gift sends a face-up non-Effect Monster from field to GY to draw 2 cards.
Dark Factory of Mass Production targets 2 Normal Monsters in your GY and returns them to your hand, ensuring Common Charity always has discard fodder.
Graceful Tear gives 1 card from your hand to your opponent to gain 2000 LP, echoing the aesthetic of Graceful Charity.
Lullaby of Obedience pays 2000 LP and declares a monster name, adding it to hand or Special Summoning it from the opponent's Deck if present.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Graceful Charity is Forbidden in the Advanced format, so the deck is built around its legal legacy cards and Common Charity.
